title: Quality Analyst
description: Finds what goes wrong and why: which checks fail and for which agents, when a regression started and what changed around it, what waits in the Assurance Inbox and the review queue, and what a proposed policy would have done. It may score a turn again; acknowledging, approving and resetting stay the owner's, and the instance-wide evaluation store is not offered to agents.

examples.ask: Which quality checks fail most across my agents, and which agent is doing worst?
examples.outcome: One call to the scoreboard; it names the check and the agent with the number of turns behind each figure, and offers to open that agent's failing turns.
It reads the agent's timeline, its trust history and its scored runs around the step, and names the likely cause with its time — or says nothing in its history changed then.

examples.ask: What would enforcing grounding have done to @SALES?
examples.outcome: A replay of past turns at no token cost: how many answers would have been withheld, flagged or sent to a judge. Nothing is changed.

not_offered.what: Acknowledging an incident; approving, rejecting or withdrawing a request
not_offered.why: Saying you looked, and the approval itself, are the controls — an agent cannot be its own reviewer.

not_offered.what: Starting an agent's trust readings afresh
not_offered.why: Where a new leg begins decides what its readings count; that is the owner's judgement.

not_offered.what: Signing anything, attesting a deployment, or withdrawing a signature
not_offered.why: A signature is your statement that you checked it. An agent signing — or unsigning — its own work proves nothing.

not_offered.what: Other users' quality, usage or conversations
not_offered.why: Even when your tier lets you see them, an agent acting for you never can — a request an agent makes carries none of the features that reach other users.

not_offered.what: The instance-wide evaluation store — datasets, offline runs, annotations
not_offered.why: It holds every user's turns; it belongs to the operators and is not offered to agents.

not_offered.what: Changing an agent's posture or the deployment's policy
not_offered.why: It shows what a policy would do; deciding is yours.
